command.name: command
command.purpose: Route an operator's question to the specialists that can answer it, run them in an order where each informs the next, and put any recommendation through the Critic.

intents.label: Which vessels need intervention?
intents.description: Traces live events to the fleet, then scores the routing of the worst-exposed vessel. Ends at the Critic because it produces routing recommendations.

intents.label: What is happening at this port?
intents.description: Observed port state plus a simulated forward view, with the weather driving it.

intents.label: Should we advise a vessel to change its arrival?
intents.description: Builds the evidence for an arrival or speed advisory and drafts one for a controller. The draft is never visible to the vessel until issued.

intents.label: Can this cargo make a connection?
intents.description: Feasible transshipment connections, with capacity, window and handling checked.

intents.label: What happens if this shock lands?
intents.description: Propagates a shock through the lane network and reports per-port deltas.

intents.label: How well has PortWatch been doing?
intents.description: Reports scored history, reliability movement and policy promotion state.

intents.label: What are the conditions?
intents.description: Marine conditions and forward operational impact.

intents.label: What is happening in the world?
intents.description: The current event register with corroboration and exposure.

agents.name: global_eye
agents.purpose: Find the disruptions that matter now and trace each one through chokepoints and trade lanes to the ports and vessels it touches.
failureModes: The news bundle has not been exported, in which case no event is reported rather than an empty world being implied.
An event carries no chokepoint, so no lane exposure can be computed and the event is reported for awareness only.
No calibrated probability exists for the category, so severity and confidence are reported instead of a percentage.

agents.name: weather
agents.purpose: Report marine conditions and the forward operational impact at a port.
failureModes: The weather artefact has not been exported.
Significant wave height is not carried by the marine feed and is reported as unavailable rather than substituted.

agents.name: fleet
agents.purpose: Identify which vessels in a company fleet require intervention, and when.
failureModes: Fleet positions are simulated in this deployment and are labelled as such; no licensed AIS feed is connected.

agents.name: port_twin
agents.purpose: Report the port's operating state and how it evolves under a policy.
failureModes: No observed snapshot exists for the port.
The twin's geometry is schematic; positions carry no survey authority.

agents.name: route
agents.purpose: Score a vessel's routing against event, weather and port exposure.
failureModes: The vessel is not in the configured fleet.
Routing geometry is non-navigational and is never a passage plan.

agents.name: cargo
agents.purpose: Find and rank feasible transshipment connections at a port.
failureModes: No commercial manifest feed is connected; the manifest is schematic demo data.
No observed snapshot exists for the port.

agents.name: scenario
agents.purpose: Propagate a shock through the port network and report the deltas.
failureModes: The forecast artefact has not been exported.

agents.name: outcome
agents.purpose: Report how past claims scored, and what the system changed as a result.
failureModes: No claim has resolved yet, in which case calibration is reported as unavailable rather than perfect.

agents.name: advisory
agents.purpose: Draft a port-to-vessel advisory from computed evidence, for a controller to review. It cannot issue one.
failureModes: The advisory is not well formed and the store refuses it.
A draft is never visible to the recipient; only a controller can issue it.

critic.name: critic
critic.purpose: Check that a recommendation is supported by its evidence, physically possible, and safe to put in front of an operator.
critic.note: The Critic reports hard-constraint violations and never relaxes them. It can only lower confidence, never raise it.

boundary.note: Every agent, including the orchestrator, is capped at PROPOSE. EXECUTE tools require an ApprovalContext that can only be built from an authenticated human session, so no agent can reach one.
